copy.heading: Warning signs this week
copy.instructions: Tick any warning sign you noticed this week. Lauren will tick any you missed.

items: Checked the court booking app during tea.
Watched a padel highlight in the bathroom.
Mentioned padel to someone you had just met.
Used the phrase "fastest-growing" in any context at all.
Put the racket bag back in the boot "just for Thursday".
Explained the scoring to Mia, again.
Said "not to go on about padel, but".
